text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text:
Ueki-chan has grown even taller...
We're higher up than the clouds now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うえきちゃん、
また伸びちゃいましたね。
雲の上まで来ちゃいましたし……

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
I never thought we'd come this high...
Is it still gonna be a while before we reach the very top?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに高くなるとは思わなかったよ～
頂上に着くのは、まだまだ時間がかかっちゃうかな？

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how high it goes.
We decided we're aiming for the peak. Didn't we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれだけ先があろうと関係ないよ。
私たちは頂上を目指すって決めたんだから。
そうでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, guys? This situation isn't exactly normal, right?
Have you given up on questioning it? Helloooo?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……この状況って、ツッコミどころ満載なはずよね？
あんたたち、慣れて感覚マヒしてない？　
大丈夫？
